Kindly to prepare your figures in advance. - Bea"},{"spec_id":"spec_0119","text":"Hi all, so sorry for the long message and for the big invite list 😅 I know 90 minutes on a weeknight is a lot to ask. For the Dovetail rollout (the new resident portal) we need everyone who handles requests to actually know the system before it goes live on the 1st. I'm proposing a walkthrough Thursday 6:30-8:00pm, and I've invited all 23 committee members and volunteers.

Rough plan:
- 6:30 Logging in and resetting passwords: Nils
- 6:45 Submitting and tracking architectural requests: Yasmin
- 7:05 Dues payments and the new autopay: Ben Abernathy
- 7:25 Amenity booking (pool, clubhouse): Will
- 7:40 Maintenance tickets and who gets notified: Gus
- 7:50 Questions, plus a quick hands-on practice. Bianca will help anyone stuck.

If you only touch one area, I totally understand if you just come for your part. Sorry again, and I really appreciate you all giving up an evening for this. Reply here if Thursday is impossible and I'll try to record it.
